KAGETORALANCER-KAGETORA.title: Nagao Kagetora
KAGETORALANCER-KAGETORA.description: Advance Heaven, Chest and Feet to command the battlefield, manifest an Arts Noble Phantasm, and ascend irreversibly into Uesugi Kenshin.
KAGETORALANCER-KAGETORA.goldMonologue: Fortune is in heaven, armor in the chest, and merit in the feet. Gold still belongs in the treasury.
KAGETORALANCER-KAGETORA.eventDeathPreven: A formation does not break while its commander still stands.
KAGETORALANCER-KAGETORA.aromaPrinciple: Justice advances one deliberate step at a time.
KAGETORALANCER-KAGETORA.banter.alive.end: The next precept is already clear. Advance.
KAGETORALANCER-KAGETORA.banter.dead.endT: Do not let the formation die with its commander.
